legacy.$description: Every pre-ADR-030 custom property still read by an unmigrated stylesheet. A colour alias forwards to the token that replaced it, so an unmigrated stylesheet follows the live preset; the rest are frozen at the value origin/main declared. Each unit drops the aliases its files stop using; the last one deletes this file. The names the visual flip took off this layer are listed in src/__tests__/styles/resolved-token-snapshot.test.ts.
